caption: The drawing features three horizontal strips of lace, each positioned separately from one another on a plain, light-colored background. The lace strips are depicted in shades of grey, with intricate detailing typical of lace patterns. The top strip has a repeating design with a small mesh background and features some larger, more solid decorative elements, possibly including floral or abstract shapes, and a scalloped lower edge. The middle strip also displays a fine netted ground, decorated with small, regularly spaced motifs, as well as a more pronounced scalloped bottom border that incorporates additional ornamental shapes. The bottom strip is denser in decoration, with a tighter mesh and repeated wave-like patterns along its lower edge, bordered by tiny fringe details at the very bottom. All three lace samples are rendered with meticulous line work to convey texture and pattern, and the overall composition is centered with ample margin space surrounding the strips.
title: Lace Edging
